caption: Two identical blocks double their frontage: the left one about its centre (B), the right one anchored on its right flank (Shift+B), so its grid stands offset from its centre. Both are then ordered on the same 60-degree turn. The anchored block's outer man swings on a longer arm, so its pivot is now paced from that arm: it turns more slowly and without stalling, where it used to turn as fast as the centred block, outrun its men, and stall part-way before jerking on. It still deforms somewhat during the turn, a pre-existing effect tracked separately.
